title: bob-pipeline slice manifest
description: Specifier output per slice (<bob_root>/.bob/features/<feature>.manifest.yaml); consumed by scripts/plan_conformance.py.

allowed_paths.description: Globs of files the coder may create or modify; a superset of the slice's `files`.

new_types.description: Every new top-level type the slice introduces.

purpose.description: One sentence: why this type exists (PR description, 1.9.0).

locked_tests.description: Globs of tests the coder must not touch.

kind.description: Run kind of the slice (1.9.0); bugfix enables the KISS gates (scripts/bugfix_gates.py).

structural.description: Pure tidy slice: every commit is checked as structural (scripts/tidy_first.py).

root_cause.description: bugfix: production file, optionally #method, where the defect lives.

regression_test.description: bugfix: globs/paths of the red regression test committed by the Specifier (also in locked_tests).

test_exempt.description: bugfix: reason no regression test is possible (config/SQL/yaml without a seam).

seam.description: bugfix: Type.Member seams the regression test needs, stubbed before the fix.

budget.description: bugfix: override of bugfix.max_added_lines / max_files; a reason is required.

allow.description: bugfix: gate waivers granted by the Specifier.

adr.description: Path of the ADR for an architectural slice (new interface or module edge); scripts/adr_gate.py.

adr_exempt.description: Reason an architectural slice needs no ADR.
